$note: Opening a Word document as Markdown, approved 2026-10-06 (DL-123). kind=board: a part of the window drawn on the Design canvas, exported as static HTML.

screens.shows: The .docx opens in Quick Look with the notice bar: Convert to Markdown (default), Open With, Show in Finder.
NOT CHOSEN (DL-123 picked A): the same offer as a sheet on open.
<name>.md exists: a Duo question with the path and its age, a Save new as field filled with a free name (Report 2.md), Cancel, Replace, Open Existing, Convert (default).
Converting, after half a second: a progress bar, what it's doing, Cancel.
The copy takes the .docx's tab: Converted from Report.docx. The Word document is unchanged; the summary; Undo Conversion, Open Original, OK (default).
With gaps: Not carried over: …, then Also: ….
Couldn't convert: why, Nothing was written and what to do; Open With (default), Show in Finder; the preview or No preview below.
Damaged, the older Word format (read only), nothing to convert (Convert Anyway).
